x: Geoff North, now free of injury but still not fully fit, showed up quite well at Sutton Coldfield where he placed 6th behind a Coventry quartet and Herriott.

John Bicourt carried Surrey's vest momentarily to the front but the Herriott/Pomfret international partnership set a sizzling pace that soon had the field strung out, with John relegated to eighth, fractionally ahead of a menacing group.

Of the four G.B. athletes to have achieved Olympic qualifying standard, three were in his heat (Herriott, Bryan-Jones and Ashton). In addition there was Reading's international, Gerry Stevens and Szabo of Hungary.
